Name: Ram, Son of Hezron
Summary: Ram appears in Ruth's genealogy as the son of Hezron and father of Amminadab, in the line from Pharez to David.
KeyStory: Ram stands in the closing genealogy between Hezron and Amminadab, in the line that runs from Pharez to David.
LifeLesson: One generation's whole record can be a single line — and still matter.
